title: lithocarpus vidalii
intro: Lithocarpus vidalii, commonly known as the Vidal's tanbark oak or Philippine tanbark oak, is a species of evergreen tree in the beech family Fagaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity, which may contribute to its use in treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Lithocarpus vidalii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
